description: This file is a jQuery plugin called 'Jeditable' that enables in-place editing of HTML elements. It defines the plugin's core functions, input types (text, textarea, select), default settings, and methods for enabling, disabling, and destroying editable elements.

methods.name: editable
methods.description: Main method to initialize or control in-place editing on selected elements. Supports enabling, disabling, destroying, and setting up editable fields with options.

methods.name: addInputType
methods.description: Adds a new custom input type to the plugin.
